summary: HMIC-001 v1.5 TRUST-ENROLLMENT / SIGNING AUTHORITY-SCOPE ALIGNMENT IMPLEMENTED -- INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION PENDING. Implemented exactly the target reconciled by Phase 149O.20L.7O.2G.1 (finding B-149O.20L.7O.2G-1): HMIC-001 amended v1.4 to v1.5 -- HMIC-REQ-052 widened with a new closure limb (d) binding the Trust-Enrollment/signing authority surface via a dual-anchor construction (reachability anchor: hatp_signing_ceremony.py's production_sign_rollback_evidence, the module's sole production signing-ceremony entry point; non-reachability anchor: the hardware-credential and principal/signer administrative writers in hatp_hardware_credential_admin.py and hatp_principal_signer_admin.py, mirroring limb (c)'s own precedent from the DeploymentBinding producer). HMIC-REQ-050's literal enumeration widened from thirty to thirty-five files: twenty-six src/pcae/-relative entries (twenty-three current plus hatp_signing_ceremony.py, hatp_hardware_credential_admin.py, hatp_principal_signer_admin.py) and nine repository-root-relative entries (seven current plus HATP_PRINCIPAL_SIGNER_ENROLLMENT_CONTRACT.md [HPSE-001] and HATP_HARDWARE_CREDENTIAL_ENROLLMENT_CONTRACT.md [HHCE-001], positioned after HBDC-001 and before the two scripts entries per the contract's own presentation-order convention). HMIC-REQ-053 widened from five to seven contract files receiving direct digest-content binding; HMIC-REQ-067 widened contract_versions from five to seven members, adding HPSE-001 v1.1 and HHCE-001 v1.1 with both content and version binding from the moment of admission -- never as a deferred, disclosed exception the way HBDC-001's v1.2 addition originally was -- per HMIC-REQ-053's existing, current uniform-coverage rule ('no contract_versions member is exempted from the digest binding'), a mechanical consequence of that rule's own text rather than a new discretionary choice by this phase. HMIC-REQ-069 updated to 'seven entries as of v1.5'. The attack matrix widened from thirty-nine to forty-two scenarios: row 40 mirrors rows 11/13/37/38/39's IMPLEMENTATION_MISMATCH mechanism for the new limb-(d) source triad; rows 41/42 mirror row 37's HBDC-001 same-version content-drift precedent for HPSE-001 and HHCE-001 respectively. New contract section 59 (Contract Amendment History -- Phase 149O.20L.7O.2H, v1.5) records the full worked closure-limb analysis, the current-30/5-baseline reconstruction, the fresh static and semantic dependency-graph walk of the Trust-Enrollment/signing triad, the authority-sensitive/excluded-leaf classification (pcae.core.paths/provenance/git_status/tasks all correctly excluded on established precedent), the full transitive authority-bearing coverage matrix, HPSE-001/HHCE-001 byte-identity and digest-sensitivity proofs, the over-/under-binding threat analysis, the v1.4-to-v1.5 version-bump rationale, and an explicit, disclosed scope decision on _CONTRACT_VERSIONS_REQUIRED_KEYS (below). Production src/pcae/core/hatp_mandatory_certification.py was aligned in the same phase as the contract amendment, per the 149O.20L.7K same-phase precedent rather than 149O.20K's split contract-then-alignment sequencing: _FROZEN_SRC_PCAE_RELATIVE_FILES (23 to 26), _FROZEN_REPOSITORY_ROOT_RELATIVE_FILES (7 to 9), _FROZEN_AUTHORITY_BEARING_FILES's count assertion (30 to 35), _CONTRACT_IDENTITY_FILES (5 to 7), the module docstring, and the two error classes' docstrings (FrozenFileDerivationError, ContractIdentityDerivationError) were all updated; no other production behavior changed. Self-binding is unaffected: hatp_mandatory_certification.py is itself frozen member #19 and its own widened bytes participate in the digest it computes, identical to the already-safely-used v1.3/v1.4 pattern, with digests always computed fresh at validation time and no stale-cache hazard. Scoped, not fully reconciled: the governing prompt asked this phase to reconcile the contract-version parser/required-key set. Direct inspection found _CONTRACT_VERSIONS_REQUIRED_KEYS (a separate, Wave-A-owned CertificationRecord closed-schema constant used only by _require_contract_versions, distinct from Wave B's own _CONTRACT_IDENTITY_FILES/derive_contract_versions) was, and had been since well before this phase, a four-member literal (HMRC-001/HATP-001/HSCE-001/RAE-001) that had never itself been widened to include HBDC-001 when _CONTRACT_IDENTITY_FILES gained it at v1.2 -- a pre-existing, disclosed drift Phase 149O.20L.7O.2G first surfaced and Phase 149O.20L.7O.2G.1 independently reconfirmed present, unchanged, and explicitly out of that phase's own scope. This phase widens _CONTRACT_VERSIONS_REQUIRED_KEYS strictly additively, by this phase's own two new members only (four to six: HMRC-001/HATP-001/HSCE-001/RAE-001/HPSE-001/HHCE-001), leaving the pre-existing HBDC-001 gap untouched exactly as 2G.1 left it -- closing that unrelated, pre-existing drift is outside this phase's own additive, limb-(d)-scoped charter and is deferred to a future, separately-governed repair phase. derive_contract_versions (Wave B) is unaffected and continues to return the full, correct seven-member mapping; only the separate Wave A closed-schema acceptance set for a stored CertificationRecord is six, not seven, members. A new 36-test focused suite (tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7o_2h_hmic_trust_enrollment_signing_closure_limb_d.py) covers all 28 items of the governing prompt's required-test list: exact 26/9/35/7 membership counts, no-duplicate/no-missing frozen paths, exact contract-to-production source-set and contract-version equality, the closed six-member contract_versions schema (with the disclosed HBDC-001 exception documented and tested), the three new Python files and HPSE-001/HHCE-001 contract content's inclusion, retention of all thirty pre-2H members, per-new-member digest sensitivity, HPSE-001/HHCE-001 dynamic version derivation, same-version content-drift digest sensitivity for both new contracts, closure-limb-(d) call-graph verification (anchor function and writer entry points present, every import bound-or-excluded-leaf), Class-B/DeploymentBinding retention, rejection of a pre-2H four-member CertificationRecord and of an unknown seventh contract key, deterministic repeated digest derivation, self-bound certification-module inclusion, proof of no certification-storage-artifact creation and unchanged Observed/observe/unavailable runtime state, HMIC-REQ-053's uniform content-binding coverage, HPSE-001/HHCE-001 header parsing, and a zero-commits-since-phase-entry check on the four signing/hardware authority files BF-1/BF-2/B-149O.20L.7O.2F.3-1/B-149O.20L.7O.2F.3-2 depend on -- all 36 passed. A repository-wide sweep of the hmic/hatp_mandatory_certification, signing_ceremony/hardware_credential_admin/principal_signer_admin/fido2, and class_b/deployment_binding test selections was compared node-for-node against a git-stash-derived pre-phase baseline; this phase's widening initially surfaced 215+27 additional node failures, overwhelmingly (a) old phases' own 'current live state is exactly N' assertions predating this additive widening and (b) isolated-fixture tests whose synthetic _CONTRACT_IDENTITY_FILES monkeypatch had not also monkeypatched the previously-coincidentally-matching _CONTRACT_VERSIONS_REQUIRED_KEYS -- all repaired using this repository's own established additive-amendment pattern (exact-count assertions widened to tolerant >=/subset comparisons carrying a docstring recording the prior exact value and the amendment that widened it; docstring-only diffs in derive_contract_versions/ContractIdentityDerivationError/FrozenFileDerivationError excluded from byte-identity comparisons; isolated fixtures given the matching monkeypatch). Zero functional regressions were found in any of those sweeps; hatp_signing_ceremony.py, hatp_fido2_provider.py, hatp_hardware_credential_admin.py, and hatp_principal_signer_admin.py were not touched by this phase, and BF-1, BF-2, B-149O.20L.7O.2F.3-1, and B-149O.20L.7O.2F.3-2 remain independently closed at their implementation boundaries, unaffected and not reopened. Fast Green (isolated disposable git-worktree at this phase's own entry commit e65b4ce0, -m fast_green -n auto, compared against post-commit current source in the identical environment): fixed 304 non-passing/8160 passed/4 skipped/9 errors; current 306 non-passing/8194 passed/4 skipped/9 errors. Exact non-passing-node comm diff: two current-only nodes, zero fixed-only nodes, zero error-node-set diff. Both current-only nodes independently classified as non-blocking: test_phase_149o_20l_7n_1_dell_redeployment_proposition_independent_verification.py::TestCandidateCurrentness::test_head_equals_origin_main failed only because HEAD was ahead of origin/main between this phase's commit and its push, and passes once pushed (confirmed HEAD equals origin/main post-push, zero commits ahead); tests/test_shell_gate.py::TestAuditPersistence::test_audit_verify_cli is the exact system-load-induced 15-second subprocess-timeout flake this repository's own prior phases (149O.20L.7O.2G, 149O.20L.7O.2G.1) already diagnosed under the identical concurrent-parallel-run condition, independently re-run in isolation immediately after and confirmed to pass at 9.67 seconds -- this phase touched zero shell-gate/audit-related files. Zero durable regressions attributable to this phase's own changes. Finding B-149O.20L.7O.2G-1 disposition: ALIGNED -- 35-MEMBER CONTENT/SOURCE IDENTITY IMPLEMENTED -- 7-MEMBER CONTRACT IDENTITY IMPLEMENTED -- INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION PENDING -- NOT CLOSED (this phase does not close its own finding; only a future independent-verification phase may). Class-B verifier files, DeploymentBinding admin producer/script, and CBV-S1 remain unaffected and unchanged; CBV-S10 remains OPEN, untouched, no readiness integration wired. No HMIC certification was created or activated at any point. No HATP activation, FIDO2 provisioning, real Principal/Signer enrollment, or real DeploymentBinding creation occurred. No hac-dell or Protected Root state was mutated. Runtime remains Observed/observe/unavailable throughout, confirmed via pcae runtime inspect both before and after this phase's changes.
